tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyi gnas brgyad pa'i tshig 'grel bzhugs/

gnyis pa snyoms 'jug gi yon tan gtan la dbab pa la/ snyoms 'jug gi rang bzhin/ de'i khyad chos/ ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi dbye ba/ de la brten pa'i yon tan bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po la/ snyoms 'jug gnyis so sor bshad pa/ thun mong du bshad pa/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag bye brag tu bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ dbye ba spyir bstan pa dang*/ snyoms 'jug bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan dag ni rnam gnyis bzhi/ /der skye ba dag rab tu bshad/ /ces byung*/ 'di la/ tshig don/ spyi don/ mtha' dpyad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan dag ni chos can/ rnam pa gnyis yod de/ rgyu snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan dang*/ 'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gtan gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis re re la'ang bzhi bzhi yod de/ rang rang gi bsam gtan dang po nas bzhi pa'i bar yod pa'i phyir/ der skye ba'i bsam gtan dag ni 'dir rgyas par mi 'chad de/ rgyu snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan chung 'bring che gsum gyis 'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gtan bzhi la gnas gsum gsum dang*/ gnas gtsang du skye ba'i rgyu spel sgom dang gnas lnga po ni sngar rab tu bshad zin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sgra don/ sa 'tshams dang bzhi/ dang po yod de/ bsam gtan gyi sas bsdus pa'i sgo nas bzhi sems gcig pa de/ bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de la dbye na gnyis yod de/ der gyur pa'i nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ dang po la bzhi yod de/ dang po'i nyer bsdogs sogs bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ dang po'i nyer bsdogs la gnyis yod de/ zhi gnas skabs kyi nyer bsdogs dang lhag mthong skabs kyi nyer bsdogs gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ phyi ma la drug yod de/ mtshan nyid so sor rig pa dang*/ mos pa yid byed dang*/ rab tu dben pa yid byed/

dga' ba stud pa'i yid byed/ dpyod pa yid byed/ sbyor ba mtha'i yid byed dang drug yod pa'i phyir/ yid byed bdun pa sbyor mtha'i 'bras bu yid byed ni nyer bsdogs min te/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ yang ngo bo'i sgo nas gnyis yod de/ dag pa dang nyams pa cha mthun gnyis yod do/ yang gnas pa cha mthun/ khyad par cha mthun/ nges 'byed cha mthun sogs kyang yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sgra don yod de/ 'dis sems par byed pas na bsam gtan zhes bya ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa sa 'tshams yod de/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs thob pa nas yod pa'i phyir/gsum pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig/rgyu snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan dang 'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gtan gang rung yin na/ bsam gtan yin pas khyab zer na/ bsam gtan dang po ba'i gzugs phung chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ de der thal/ rgyu snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan gyi dbang gis der skyes pa'i gang zag gi phung po lnga po de yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig/de gang rung yin na/ snyoms 'jug ma yin pas khyab zer na/ bsam gtan bzhi ka'i so skye'i rgyud kyi skyes thobs kyi sa thob pa'i snyoms 'jug dag pa ba chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ 'bras bu skye ba'i de yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig/rgyu snyoms 'jug yin na/ shes pa yin pas khyab zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ rgyu snyoms 'jug de ngo bo rjes 'brang dang bcas na phung po lnga pa can yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig/snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can de snyoms 'jug yin zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ de dge ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de ni nyon mongs can la snyoms 'jug gi sgras brjod pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig/'dod pa'i sas bsdus pa'i bsam gzugs med pa ltar 'dod khams pa'i rgyud la'ang de dag med zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ 'dod pa'i mi'i rgyud la bsam gzugs brgyad yod pa'i phyir/

der thal/ de yod kyang de 'dod pa'i sas bsdus pa ma yin pa'i khyad par 'thad pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ snyoms 'jug dge ba rtse gcig pa/ /rjes 'brang bcas na phung po lnga/ /dpyod dang dga' dang bde dang ldan/ /yan lag snga ma spangs pa yi/ /zhes byung*/ /bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug chos can/ khyod kyi ngo bo bzhag tu yod de/ yan lag gi sgo nas 'og sa la chags bral byas pa'i dge sems rtse gcig de de yin pa'i phyir/ phung po lnga dang bcas te/ rjes 'brang dang bcas na phung po lnga pa can yin pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug chos can/ khyod kyi ngo bo yod de/ rtog dpyod dang dga' ba dang bde ba dang dge sems rtse gcig pa dang ldan pa'i bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug de de yin pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gnyis pa nas bzhi pa'i bar gyi snyoms 'jug chos can/ ngo bo'i khyad par yod de/ yan lag snga ma snga ma spangs pa'i sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir te/ rim pa bzhin du dpyod pa dang bral ba'i sgo nas dang*/ dpyod pa dang dga' ba gnyis dang bral ba dang*/ dpyod dga' bde ba gsum dang bral ba'i sgo nas bzhag pa'i snyoms 'jug gsum ni bsam gtan gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i ngo bor 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ dbye ba/ thob tshul/ dmigs pa'i khyad/ so so'i ngo bo dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ de bzhin gzugs med phung po bzhi/ /zhes byung*/ gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug chos can/ khyod la gnyis yod pa'i bsam gtan de bzhin du rgyu snyoms 'jug gi gzugs med dang 'bras bu skye ba'i gzugs med gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de re re la'ang bzhi bzhi yod de/ nam mkha' mtha' yas/ rnam shes mtha' yas/ ci yang med/ 'du shes med min gyi bar bzhi bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ rjes 'brang dang bcas na phung po bzhi pa can yin te/ gzugs phung ma gtogs pa bzhi dang bcas pa'i phyir/ ngo bo yod de/

dmigs pa'i sgo nas 'og sa las 'da' ba'i rigs gnas kyi snyoms 'jug de de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'og ma'i sa las dben las skyes/ /zhes byung*/ gzugs gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug gi dngos gzhi chos can/ 'thob tshul yod de/ rang rang gi 'og ma'i sa las dben pa las te chags bral gyi ngo bor skyes pa'i tshul gyis thob pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ nyer bsdogs gsum dang bcas par ni/ gzugs kyi 'du shes bshig ces bya/ /gzugs med pa na gzugs med do/ /gzugs ni sems las skyes par 'gyur/ /zhes byung*/ gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi bzhi dang gzugs med phyi ma gsum gyi nyer bsdogs dang bcas pa chos can/ gzugs kyi 'du shes rnam par bshig pa'am bral ces bya ste/ de'i 'du shes rags ba mi rgyu ba'i phyir/ phal chen sde pa sogs 'ga' zhig/gzugs med khams na gzugs yod par 'dod kyang*/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i bye smra'i lugs la gzugs med khams na gzugs med de/ de med kyang gang zag mi rung ba ni min pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i gang zag ni ming bzhi'i phung po tsam gyis phye ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na/ gzugs med nas khams 'og ma gnyis su skyes pa'i tshe gzugs rgyun chad bar 'gyur snyam na/ de la bye smra na re/ skyon med de/ der skyes pa'i gzugs dang po ni gzugs med pa'i 'chi kha'i sems kyis lhan cig byed rkyen byas pa las skye ba'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i tshe gzugs can dang mthun pa'i sems kyi rgyun dag gis lhan cig byed rkyen dang rnam smin gyi rgyu sngar 'gags las gzugs de skye bar 'gyur ba'i phyir zer/ mdo sde pa na re/ skyon med de/ gzugs dang po de ni gzugs kyi rnam smin gyi rgyus bsgos pas sems kyi 'jug pa rang rgyud la rnyed pa de las skye ba'i phyir zer/ slob dpon sogs shing rta chen po gzhan dag na re/ skyon med de/

gzugs dang po de rang nyid bskyed pa'i bag chags las byung bas/ bag chags de gzugs de'i nyer len du 'dod pa'i phyir/ de gzugs med na'ang yod de/ de ldan min 'du byed yin pa'i phyir te/ de ltar thar lam gsal byed dang sde bdun dka' 'grel las kyang bshad pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa dmigs rnam ni/ rnam shes mtha' yas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas/ /ci yang med ces bya de ltar/ /sbyor phyir dman phyir 'du shes med/ /'du shes med pa'ang ma yin pa'o/ /zhes byung*/ nam mkha' mtha' yas sogs bzhir brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ yod de/ sbyor ba'i dus su rnam shes mtha' yas so snyam pa dang*/ nam mkha' mtha' yas so snyam pa dang*/ ci yang med do ces bya bar de ltar yid la byed cing de dag la rab tu sbyor ba'i phyir na rnam shes mtha' yas sogs su rim pa bzhin du brjod pa'i phyir/ 'du shes med 'du shes med pa'ang min pa'i snyoms 'jug chos can/ khyod kyi sgra don yod de/ sbyor ba'i dus su 'du shes ni nad do 'bras so zug rngu'o snyam du 'du shes dman pa'i phyir dang dngos gzhi'i tshe 'du shes rags pa yod pa yang min la phra ba med pa min no snyam pa'i snyoms 'jug yin pas de ltar 'jog pa'i phyir/gnyis pa thun mong du bshad pa ni/ de ltar snyoms 'jug dngos gzhi'i rdzas/ /rnam pa brgyad bdun rnam pa gsum/ /ro myang ldan dang dag pa ba/ /zag med brgyad pa rnam pa gnyis/ /ro myang mtshungs ldan sred bcas so/ /'jig rten pa yi dge ba ni/ /dag pa de ni des myang bya/ /zag med 'jig rten 'das pa'o/ / zhes byung*/ de ltar snyoms 'jug dngos gzhi'i rdzas chos can/ /rnam pa brgyad du 'dod de/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi bzhi bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ srid rtse ma gtogs bdun po chos can/ rnam pa gsum gsum yod de/ ro myang ldan dang dag pa ba dang zag med gsum re yod pa'i phyir/ brgyad pa srid rtse chos can/

rnam pa gnyis yod de/ ro myang dang mtshungs ldan dang dag pa ba gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can chos can/ ngo bo'i khyad par yod de/ snyoms 'jug dag pa ba'i rdzas ro myang gi sred pa sogs gang rung dang bcas pa zhig de yin pa'i phyir/ dag pa de chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ 'jig rten pa'i dge bas bsdus pa'i snyoms 'jug zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir/ dag pa 'di ni chos can/ khyod snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can des myang bar bya ba yin te/ de khyod la zhen nas nyon mongs can du skyes pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi zag med chos can/ khyod kyi ngo bo 'jog tshul yod de/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i snyoms 'jug bag med zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir/gsum pa yan lag bye brag tu bshad pa la/ dbye ba dang bsdu ba dang nyon mongs can yan lag ldan tshul dang zhar byung bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ dang po la lnga rtog dpyod dang*/ /dge dang bde ba ting 'dzin rnams/ /gnyis pa la ni yan lag bzhi/ /rab dang dang ni dga' la sogs/ /gsum pa la lnga btang snyoms dang*/ /dran dang shes bzhin bde dang gnas/ /mtha' na bzhi dran btang snyoms dang*/ /bde min sdug min ting 'dzin rnams/ /zhes byung*/ bsam gtan dang po chos can/ khyod la lnga yod de/ rtog dpyod gnyen po'i yan lag dang*/ dga' ba dang bde ba phan yon gyi yan lag /ting nge 'dzin gnas kyi yan lag rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gnyis pa chos can/ khyod la yan lag bzhi yod de/ nang rab tu dang ba gnyen po'i dang*/ dga' ba dang sogs kyis bde ba phan yon gyi dang*/ rtse gcig pa gnas kyi yan lag rnams yod pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gsum pa chos can/ khyod la yan lag lnga yod de/ btang snyoms dang dran pa dang shes bzhin gnyen po'i dang*/ bde ba phan yon gyi dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gnas kyi yan lag rnams yod pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi mtha' bzhi pa chos can/ khyod na yan lag bzhi yod de/

dran pa dang btang snyoms gnyen po'i dang*/ bde min dug bsngal yang min pa'i tshor ba phan yon gyi dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gnas kyi yan lag rnams dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de dag gi byed las yod de/ bsam gtan dang po'i yan lag rtog dpyod gnyis kyis 'dod pa'i skyon dang bsam gtan gyi yon tan tshol/ phan yon la dga' bde 'byung*/ de dag gi rten ting nge 'dzin gyis byed pa/gnyis pa'i yan lag nang rab tu dang bas rtog dpyod la skyon du lta zhing*/ gzhan sngar ltar dang*/ gsum pa'i yan lag 'du byed btang snyoms kyis dga' ba la yid mi gtong*/ dran pas rgyu mtshan mi brjed/ shes bzhin gyis srung bar byed pas dga' ba spong*/ gzhan sngar ltar dang*/ bzhi pa'i yan lag dran pa dang btang nyoms kyis bsam gtan gyi bde ba spong zhing*/ gzhan sngar ltar 'dra ba'i phyir/ yan lag bco brgyad po de dag chos can/ khyod la yan lag zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mtshon par byed pa dang rjes su mthun pa dang tshogs pas na de skad ces brjod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ dngos dang*/ dogs gcod gnyis/ dang po ni/ rdzas su bcu gcig /ces byung*/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag chos can/ khyod la ming gi sgo nas bco brgyad yod kyang rdzas su bcu gnyis yod de/ dang po'i lnga dang gnyis pa'i nang rab tu dang ba dang gsum pa'i btang snyoms dran pa shes bzhin bzhi dang bzhi pa'i btang snyoms rnams su 'du ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa dogs gcod ni/ dang po ni/ shin tu sbyangs pa bde ba yin/ rab tu dang ba dang ba yin/ lung rnam gnyis phyir yid dga' bde/ /zhes byung*/ de la kho na re/ bsam gtan gsum pa'i bde ba de dang po gnyis kyi bde ba las rdzas gzhan ji ltar yin zhe na/ bye smra na de/ de las rdzas gzhan yin te/ bsam gtan dang po gnyis na shin tu sbyangs pa'i 'bad pa yin gyi tshor ba de ma yin pa'i phy-ir/ gnyis pa'i nang rab tu dang pa yod de/ bsam gtan la yid ches pa'i dad pa zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir/

bsam gtan gsum pa'i bde ba ni yid bde yin la/ dga' ba ni yid bde las gzhan pa'i tshor bar 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag ston pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi lung rnam pa gnyis dang 'gal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ nyon mongs can la dga' bde dang*/ /rab dang shes bzhin dran pa dang*/ /btang snyoms dran pa dag pa med/ kha cig shin tu sbyangs btang snyoms/ /zhes byung*/ nyon mongs can gy-i bsam gtan bzhi chos can/ khyod la yan lag gang med pa'i tshul yod de/ khyod kyi dang po la dga' bde med/ gnyis pa la nang rab tu dang ba med/ /gsum pa la shes bzhin dang dran pa med/ bzhi pa la btang snyoms dang dran pa dag pa ba med pa'i phyir/ kha cig/de'i dang po gnyis na shin tu sbyangs ba med cing gzhan gnyis na btang snyoms med de/ de gnyis dge ba'i sa mang po ba yin pa'i phyir zer/ bzhi ba la/ bsam gtan bzhi pa mi g.yo ba'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ 'bras bu skye bas thob pa'i bsam gtan la tshor ba'i ldan tshul/ bsam gtan gnyis par 'og ma'i sems mngon du byed tshul gsum/ dang po ni/ skyon brgyad las ni grol ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa g.yo ba med pa yin/ rtog dang dpyod dang dbugs dag dang*/ bde ba la sogs bzhi yin no/ /zhes byung*/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi chos can/ khyod la g.yo ba med pa yin te/ bsam gtan g.yo byed kyi skyon brgyad las ni grol ba'i phyir/ g.yo byed kyi skyon brgyad yod de/ der gyur pa'i rtog pa dang dpyod pa dang*/ dbugs 'byung rngub dag dang*/ bde ba la sogs te sdug bsngal dang yid bde mi bde bzhi dang bcas pa yin pa'i phyir/ g.yo tshul yod de/ dang por rtog dpyod kyis sems g.yo/ gnyis par dga' bdes sems ya ya bor byed/ gsum par bde bas cha mthun tsam zhig ma zhi bar byed pa sogs yod pas g.yo la/ bzhi pa la ni de dag med pas mi g.yo ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ skye ba'i bsam gtan dag na ni/

/yid bde bde dang btang snyoms dang*/ /btang snyoms yid bde bde ba dang*/ /btang snyoms btang snyoms tshor ba yod/ /ces byung*/ 'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gtan chos can/ khyod dang po na tshor ba gsum dang*/ gnyis pa dag na gnyis yod de/ dang po na yid bde dang tshor bde btang snyoms dang gsum yod/ gnyis pa na btang snyoms dang yid bde ba gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de'i gsum pa na'ang gnyis yod de/ sems tshor bde ba dang btang snyoms gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa na gcig kho na yod de/ btang snyoms kyi tshor ba kho na yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i sas bsdus kyi tshor ba gzhan med pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gnyis pa sogs na lus mig dang*/ rna ba'i rnam shes rnam rig blo/ /gang yin de ni dang por gtogs/ /de lung ma bstan nyon mongs min/ /zhes byung*/ 'o na 'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gtan gnyis pa sogs kyi gang zag la mig rna lus kyi rnam shes gsum med dam zhe na/ de'i gang zag la ni mig sogs gsum yod cing de dag gi rnam shes kyang yod pa yin la/ de'i bsam gtan gnyis pa sogs na yod pa'i lus dang mig dang rna ba'i rnam par shes pa rnams dang*/ de dag gi rnam rig gi blo kun slong rtog dpyod yod pa gang yin pa de ni rang sas ma bsdus kyi/ bsam gtan dang por gtogs te de'i sas bsdus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sogs kyi rnam shes de rnams dang kun slong ni/ lung ma bstan yin te/ dgos dbang gis skye ba tsam yin pas dge ba min la/ sa 'og mar chags bral byas pas nyon mongs can min pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa de dag gi khyad chos la/ thob tshul/ thob zin mngon du byed tshul/ dmigs pa'i khyad par/ spang bya spong tshul nyer bsdogs dang bcas pa bzhi/ dang po la/ dngos dang*/ snyoms 'jug gang gi mjug tu snyoms 'jug du 'byung la dpyad pa/ dag pa ba'i dbye ba zhar byung thod rgal gyi rnam gzhag dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ de dang mi ldan 'dod chags bral/

/skye ba las ni dag pa 'thob/ /zag med 'dod chags bral ba yi/ /nyon mongs can rnams skye ba yis/ /zhes byung*/ snyoms 'jug dag pa ba dang zag med dang nyon mongs can gsum chos can/ 'thob tshul yod de/ khyod las dag pa ba ni sngar dag pa ba de dang mi ldan na 'dod chags dang bral ba'i lam gyis thob la/ ldan pa ni srid rtse ma gtogs gong sa nas 'og mar skye ba las ni thob cing*/ zag med kyang de dang mi ldan pa ni 'dod chags dang bral ba yi lam gyis thob pa/ de dang ldan pa ni zad shes skyes pa dang dbang po 'pho bas kyang thob/ snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can ni yongs su nyams pa dang 'og sar skye ba yis thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ zag pa med pa'i mjug thogs su/ /ltag 'og gsum pa'i bar dag pa/ /skye'o dag pa las de bzhin/ rang gi sa ba'i nyon mongs kyang*/ /nyon mongs can las rang dag dang*/ /nyon mongs 'og ma'i dag gcig kyang*/ /'chi 'pho dag las nyon mongs kun/ /nyon mongs can las gong ma yin/ /zhes byung*/ snyoms 'jug chos can/ khyod gang gi rjes su du zhig 'byung ba'i tshul yod de/ zag pa med pa'i bsam gtan dang po'i mjug thogs su mtshon na bsam gtan gsum pa las rang gi ltag gong ma dang*/ de'i 'og ma gsum pa nas dang po'i bar gyi dag pa ba dang zag med skye la/ bsam gtan dag pa ba las snga ma de bzhin du rang sa sogs kyi dag pa ba dang*/ rang gi sa pa'i nyon mongs kyang skye/ nyon mongs can gyi bsam gtan las rang sa'i dag pa ba dang nyon mongs can dang 'og ma'i dag pa ba gcig kyang skye/ 'chi 'pho ba'i dus kyi skyes thob kyi bsam gtan dag pa ba las rang sa gong sa 'og sa gsum gyi nyon mongs can kun 'byung*/ snyoms 'jug nyon mongs can gyis 'chi sems byas na rang sa dang 'og sar skye'i/ de las gong ma'i sar skye ba ma yin pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ dag pa nyams pa cha mthun sogs/ /rnam bzhi de ni go rim bzhin/

/nyon mongs skye dang rang sa dang*/ /gong dang rjes su mthun pa'o/ / nyams cha mthun sogs mjug thogs su/ /gnyis dang gsum dang gsum dang gcig /zhes byung*/ snyoms 'jug dag pa ba chos can/ khyod la dbye na rnam pa bzhi yod de/ nyams pa cha mthun sogs kyis gnas pa cha mthun dang khyad par cha mthun dang nges 'byed cha mthun rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi po de ni chos can/ so so'i ngo bo yod de/ go rim bzhin du rang gi mjug de ma thag rang sa'i nyon mongs skye ba dang*/ rang gi de ma thag rang sa'i dag pa skye ba dang*/ rang gi de ma thag gong ma'i dag pa ba skye ba dang*/ rang gi de ma thag zag med skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa'i snyoms 'jug rnams de dag tu 'jog pa'i phyir/ nyams pa cha mthun sogs chos can/ khyod kyi mjug thogs su de bzhin du 'byung ba yod de/ dang po'i der nyams pa gnas pa gnyis dang*/ gnyis pa'i der nges 'byed cha mthun ma gtogs gsum dang*/ gsum pa'i der nyams pa cha mthun ma gtogs gsum dang*/ bzhi pa'i der nges 'byed cha mthun gcig po skye ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa thod rgal ni/ sa brgyad rnam gnyis 'brel ba dang*/ /gcig brgal song zhing 'ongs nas ni/ /rim mi mthun par gsum par 'gro /thod brgal gyi ni snyoms 'jug yin/ /zhes byung*/ 'di la thod rgal gyi sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ sgra bshad/ rten dang bzhi/ dang po la/ ring sbyor dang nye sbyor gnyis las/ dang po ring sbyor yod de/ bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi'i sa brgyad la zag bcas dang zag med rnam pa gnyis kyi sgo nas 'brel ba ste go rim lugs mthun du zag bcas brgyad la mar song zhing*/ lugs mi mthun du mar 'ongs pa'i zag bcas ring sbyor dang*/ srid rtse ma gtogs pa'i zag med bdun la yar song zhing mar 'ong ba ni zag med ring sbyor yin pa'i phyir/ nye sbyor yod de/ de'i rjes su zag bcas kyi bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par zhugs nas bsam gtan gnyis pa gcig bu brgal ba ste bor nas zag bcas kyi bsam gtan gsum pa la 'jug

/de nas bzhi pa bor nas nam mkha' mtha' yas dang*/ de nas rnam shes mtha' yas bor nas ci yang med pa 'jug cing*/ de bzhin du lugs mi mthun du 'jug pa zag bcas nye sbyor dang*/ zag med kyi bsam gtan gyi bsam gtan dang po nas gnyis pa gcig pu brgal nas gsum pa dang*/ de nas bzhi pa brgal nas nam mkha' mtha' yas dang*/ de nas rnam shes mtha' yas brgal nas ci yang med la 'jug cing*/ de bzhin du lugs mi mthun du 'gro ba ni zag med nye sbyor yin pa'i phyir te/ 'dir song ba ni lugs mthun dang 'ong ba ni de'i lugs mi mthun gyi dbang du mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir/ thod rgal gyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug chos can/ 'jug tshul yod de/ sbyor ba gnyis kyi rjes su zag bcas kyi bsam gtan dang po nas zag bcas dang ris mi mthun pa'i zag med kyi bsam gtan gsum par 'gro ba ste 'jug /de nas yang zag med dang ris mi mthun pa'i zag bcas nam mkha' mtha' yas dang*/ de nas de dang ris mi mthun pa'i zag med ci yang med pa'i skye mched la snyoms par 'jug cing*/ de bzhin du lugs mi mthun du'ang zag bcas zag med spel nas snyoms par 'jug pa ni thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug yin pa'i phyir/ sgra don yod de/ snyoms 'jug gi sa brgyad la mthar chags su min par re re bor ba'am brgal nas snyoms par 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ dang por mngon du byed pa'i rten yod de/ gling gsum gang rung dag tu dgra bcom mi g.yo ba'i chos can gyis mngon du byed pa'i phyir te/ des ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob cing*/ dgra bcom gzhan gyis dbang ma thob pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa thob zin mngon du byed tshul ni/ bsam gtan gzugs med rang dang ni/ 'og sa'i rten can 'og dgos med/ /srid rtse'i 'phags pa ci yang med/ /mngon du byas nas zag pa zad/ /ces byung*/ bsam gtan la gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug chos can/

rten yod de/ rang sa dang 'og sa'i rten can yin pa'i phyir/ spyir gong sa'i rten la 'og sa'i snyoms 'jug skyed pa'i dgos pa med de/ 'og sa dman cing gong sa khyad par du 'phags pa'i phyir/ dmigs bsal yod de/ srid rtser skyes pa'i 'phags pa srid pa tha ma bas ni ci yang med kyi snyoms 'jug mngon du bya ba nas zag pa bzad pa'i dgra bcom thob par byed pa'i phyir/gsum pa dmigs pa'i khyad par ni/ sred bcas rang gi srid la dmigs/ /bsam gtan dge yul yod dgu yin/ /gzugs med dngos gzhi dge rnams kyi/ /spyod yul zag bcas 'og ma min/ /zhes byung*/ sred pa dang bcas pa'i bsam gtan chos can/ dmigs pa yod de/ rang gi sa ba'i srid pa la dmigs pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan dge ba dag pa ba dang zag med chos can/ yul yod dgu la dmigs pa yin te/ chos thams cad la dmigs pa'i phyir/ gzugs med kyi dngos bzhi dge ba rnams chos can/ khyod kyi spyod yul yod de/ rang sa dang gong ma'i zag bcas la dmigs kyi/ 'og ma la dmigs pa ma yin pa'i phyir/bzhi pa spang bya spong tshul nyer bsdogs dang bcas pa la/ spang bya spong tshul/ nyer bsdogs kyi dbye ba/ bsam gtan gyi snyoms 'jug khyad par can bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ zag pa med pas nyon mongs rnams/ /spong ngo nyer bsdogs dag pas kyang*/ /zhes byung*/ spyir slob pa'i bsam gtan dang gzugs med kun gyis nyon mongs spong mi nus te/ de las bsam gzugs zag pa med pas ni nyon mongs rnams spong bar byed pa'i phyir/ nyer bsdogs dag pa bas kyang nyon mongs spong ba yod de/ de'i gnyen po khyad par can du 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ de dag las ni nyer bsdogs brgyad/ /dag pa bde min sdug bsngal min/ /dang po 'phags pa kha cig gsum/ /zhes byung*/ bsam gzugs de dag gi nyer bsdogs chos can/ khyod la brgyad yod de/ bsam gzugs brgyad kyi dngos gzhi la 'jug pa'i sbyor ba'am sta gon re re yin pa'i phyir/

de chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ rang gi dngos gzhi dang mi 'dra bar dag pa ba nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ tshor ba gang dang ldan pa yod de/ bde min sdug bsngal min pa'i btang snyoms dang bcas pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs chos can/ khyod la dag pa ba kho nar ma zad de/ dag pa ba dang 'phags pa ste zag med gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gcig de la gsum yod ces 'dod de/ mi lcogs med dang bcas pa gsum yod pa'i phyir zer la/ ro myang dang bcas pa gsum la 'dod pa'ang yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rtog med bsam gtan khyad par can/ /rnam gsum bde min sdug bsngal min/ /de ni tshangs chen 'bras bu can/ /zhes byung*/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi khyad par can chos can/ ngo bo 'jog tshul yod de/ rtog pa med cing dpyod pa dang bcas pa'i bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi zhig de yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ rdzas kyi sgo nas rnam pa gsum yod de/ ro myang dag pa ba zag med gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ tshor ba gang dang bcas pa yod de/ bde min sdug bsngal min pa'i tshang ba btang snyoms dang mtshungs ldan yin pa'i phyir/ de'i dag pa de ni chos can/ khyod kyi 'bras bu yod de/ tshangs pa chen por skye ba'i 'bras bu can yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba la/ khams gsum gyi sgo nas rtog bcas sogs gsum lam gyi sgo nas rnam thar sgo gsum/ lam sun pa'i sgo nas gsum/ byed pa'i sgo nas bzhir bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ man chad rtog dpyod bcas pa yi/ /ting 'dzin yan chad gnyis ka med/ /ces byung*/ rtog pa dang bcas sogs gsum gyi khyad par yod de/ bsam gtan khyad par can man chad kyi bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi nyer bsdogs dang bcas pa de rtog dpyod gnyis dang bcas pa yin/ bsam gtan khyad par can ni rtog pa mang la dpyod pa dang bcas pa yin/ khyad par can yan chad gnyis pa'i nyer bsdogs dngos gzhi gnyis nas srid rtse'i bar gyi snyoms 'jug rnams rtog pa dang dpyod pa gnyis ka med pa'i ting nge 'dzin yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ mtshan med bzhi pa'i rnam pa dang*/ stong nyid bdag med stong nyid du/ / 'jug pa'o smon pa med pa ni/ /de las gzhan bden rnam pa can/ /dag dang dri ma med de dag /dri med rnam thar sgo gsum mo/ /zhes byung*/ rnam thar sgo gsum po chos can/ khyod kyi ngo bo bzhag tu yod de/ mtshan med kyi ting nge 'dzin ni 'gog bden gyi 'gog pa zhi ba gya nom pa nges 'byung la dmigs pa'i rnam pa can yin la/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni sdug bden gyi bdag med pa dang stong pa nyid du 'jug pa'i rnam pa can yin/ smon pa med pa ni sngar bshad pa'i rnam pa drug po de las gzhan sdug bden gyi mi rtag sdug bsngal gnyis dang*/ kun 'byung dang lam bden gyi bzhi re ste rnam pa can gyi shes rab dang mtshungs ldan gyi ting nge 'dzin la 'jog pa'i phyir/ des gsum chos can/ sgo don yod de/ dri ma dag pa dang*/ dri ma med pa'i rnam par thar ba thob pa'i sgo dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ de dag chos can/ dri ma med pa'i rnam thar sgo gsum zhes bya ste/ rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ stong nyid stong nyid ces la sogs/ /gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin gsum mo/ /gnyis ni stong dang mi rtag par/ /mi slob pa la dmigs pa yin/ /mtshan ma med pa mtshan med ni/ /zhi bar ma brtags zad pa la/ /zag bcas mi nang mi g.yo la/ /nyer bsdogs bdun ni ma gtogs so/ /zhes byung*/ ting nge 'dzin gzhan gsum yang yod de/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la sogs pas smon pa med pa smon pa med pa dang*/ mtshan ma med pa mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de dag gi ngo bo yod de/ dang po gnyis ni rim bzhin mi slob pa'i rgyud kyi stong pa de de mi rtag pa la dmigs par 'jog cing*/ mtshan ma med pa mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni ma brtags zad pa ste so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa la dmigs nas 'jug pa'i zhi ba'i rnam pa can yin pa dang*/

zag bcas yin pa'i phyir/ de dag chos can/ rten gang la mngon du byed pa yod de/ mi'i nang du mngon du byed par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gang zag gang gis mngon du byed pa yod de/ mi g.yo ba'i chos can gyis mngon du byed pa'i phyir/ gong gi de dag chos can/ sa bcu gcig gis bsdus pa yod de/ nyer bsdogs tha ma bdun ma gtogs 'dod pa dang bsam gtan khyad par can dang bsam gzugs kyi dngos gzhi brgyad nyer bsdogs mi lcogs med ci rigs na yod pa'i phyir/bzhi pa ni/ dge ba'i bsam gtan dang po ni/ bde 'gyur ting 'dzin sgom pa yin/ mig gi mngon shes mthong 'gyur 'dod/ /sbyor ba las byung blo dbyer 'gyur/ /rdo rje lta bu'i bsam gtan mtha'i/ /gang yin de zag zad par 'gyur/ /zhes byung*/ gzhan yang mthong chos la bder gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin sogs bzhi gsungs pa de dag chos can/ 'jog tshul yod de/ dge ba'i bsam gtan dang po sgom pa ni mthong chos la bde 'gyur gyi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa yin la/ lha'i mig gi mngon shes dang mtshungs ldan gyi shes rab sgom pa ni mthong 'gyur gyi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa dang*/ de'i rjes kyi yid shes dang mtshungs ldan gyi shes rab sgom pa ni shes par 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin sgom pa yin pas de gnyis gcig tu byas pa la'ang der 'dod la/ 'bad pa'i sbyor ba las byung ba'i zag bcas zag med kyi yon tan kun blo gros dbye ba ste rgyas par 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin sgom pa ni blo rab tu dbye bar 'gyur ba dang*/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mtha' bzhi pa la brten pa gang yin pa de ni zag pa zad par 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa de la brten pa'i yon tan la/ tshad med dang*/ rnam thar dang zil gnon dang zad par dang de dag gi thob tshul rten dang bcas pa lnga/ dang po ni/ tshad med pa ni bzhi yin no/ /gnod sems la sogs gnyan po'i phyir/

/zhe sdang med byams snying rje yang*/ /yid bde ba ni dga' ba yin/ /btang snyoms ma chags rnam pa ni/ /kye ma bder gyur sdug bsngal dang*/ /dgar sems sems can rnams snyom pa/ /spyod yul 'dod pa'i sems can rnams/ /dga' ba bsam gtan gnyis na yod/ /gzhan ni drug na kha cig lnga/ de yis mi spong mi dag gi /nang du skyed do de gsum ldan/ /zhes byung*/ tshad med pa ni chos can/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas bzhi yin te/ byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms tshad med bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ sgra don kyang yod de/ dmigs yul sems can tshad med pa la dmigs shing*/ 'bras bu phan yon yang tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ bzhir grangs nges pa yin te/ gnod sems la sogs te rnam par 'tshe ba dang gzhan gyi phun tshogs pa mi dga' ba dang 'dod chags dang gnod sems mang ba'i gnyen po de bzhir nges pa'i phyir/ ngo bo yod de/ byams pa dang snying rje yang ngo bo zhe sdang med pa'i dge ba yin la/ dga' ba ni yid bde ba yin zhing*/ btang snyoms ni ma chags pa'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhi chos can/ khyod kyi rnam pa yod de/ kye ma sems can rnams bde bar gyur cig snyam du yid la byed pa ni byams pa dang*/ kye ma sems can rnams sdug bsngal dang bral na snyam pa de snying rje dang*/ kye ma sems can rnams dga' bar gyur cig snyam du sems pa dga' ba dang*/ kye ma sems can rnams khyad par 'dra ba'am bsnyams so snyam du yid la byed pa ni btang snyoms yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhi chos can/ spyod yul yod de/ 'dod pa'i sems can rnams la dmigs pa can yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ sa gang na yod med kyi khyad par yod de/ dga' ba tshad med bsam gtan dang po gnyis na yod/ tshad med gzhan gsum ni bsam gtan sa drug na yod pa'i phyir/ kha cig lnga na yod par 'dod de/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi bzhi dang khyad par can dang lnga na yod ces 'dod pa'i phyir/

tshad med de bzhi yis gnod sems sogs rtsa ba nas spong mi nus kyang de dag gi gnyen por bshad pa la chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ de dag gi 'gal zla'i gnyen po yin pa dang*/ de dag la gnod pa dang zil gyis gnon nus pas de'i gnyen por bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ rten gang gis skyed pa yod de/ mi dag gi nang du skyed pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ ldan tshul yod de/ dga' ba ma gtogs pa'i khyod gcig dang ldan na nges par gsum ga dang ldan dgos pa'i phyir/ dga' ba ni de ltar min te/ bsam gtan gsum pa dang bzhi pa la mi ldan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rnam thar ni/ rnam par thar brgyad dang po gnyis/ /mi sdug bsam gtan gnyis na yod/ /gsum pa mtha' na de ma chags/ /gzugs med mnyam gzhag dge rnams so/ /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'o/ /sra ba phra ba'i mjug thogs su/ rang gi dag dang 'og ma yi/ 'phags pa'i sems kyis de las ldang*/ dang po 'dod gtogs snang yul can/ /gang dag gzugs can min de dag /spyod yul gong dang rang gi sa'i/ /sdug bsngal sogs dang rjes shes phyogs/ /zhes byung*/ rnam par thar ba chos can/ khyod la brgyad yod de/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ sdug pa'i rnam thar/ gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi dang*/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar gcig ste brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ rnam thar dang po gnyis chos can/ khyad chos gsum dang ldan te/ ngo bo ni rnam par bsdos pa sogs kyi mi sdug pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ kha dog la chags pa'i gnyen po ma chags pa dang*/ sa bsam gtan dang po gnyis na yod pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa'i phyir/ rnam thar gsum pa de chos can/ khyad par gsum dang ldan te/ sa'i khyad par bsam gtan mtha' bzhi pa na yod/ ngo bo ma chags pa/ rnam pa sdug pa'i rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs med bzhi'i rnam thar chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ gzugs med kyi mnyam bzhag sas bsdus pa'i dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug dge ba dag pa ba dang*/

zag med dang nyer bsdogs rnam grol lam rnams de yin pa'i phyir/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ gnas gnyis par bshad pa'i 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug de de yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod la 'jug ldang gi sems kyi khyad par yod de/ khams gsum gyi sems phra ba ni srid rtse'i sems yin la/ de las kyang phra bar byas pa'i sems kyis snyoms par 'jug cing*/ de'i mjug thogs su srid rtse rang gi sa pa'i dag pa ba dang*/ 'og ma'i ci yang med kyi sa ba'i 'phags pa'i zag med kyi sems kyis khyod las ldang bar byed pa'i phyir/ rnam thar dang po gsum chos can/ khyod kyi spyod yul gyi khyad par yod de/ 'dod par gtogs pa'i gzugs kyi snang yul can yin pa'i phyir/ gang dag gzugs can min pa gzugs med phyi rnam thar de dag chos can/ spyod yul yod de/ gong sa dang rang gi sa pa'i sdug bsngal sogs kyis kun 'byung dang 'gog pa dang rjes shes kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i lam thams cad la dmigs pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched brgyad/ /gnyis ni rnam thar dang po bzhin/ gnyis ni gnyis pa bzhin no gzhan/ /sdug pa'i rnam par thar pa bzhin/ /zhes byung*/ zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched chos can/ brgyad yod de/ nang gzugs su 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs che chung la lta ba gnyis dang*/ nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs che chung bzang ngan sogs la lta ba gnyis te dbyibs zil gnon bzhi dang*/ nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs kha dog sngon po ser po dmar po dkar po la lta ba ste kha dog zil gnon bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ zil gnon dang po gnyis ni chos can/ rnam thar bzhi'i dang po bzhin yin te/ ngo bo ma chags pa'i dge ba dang*/ sa bsam gtan dang po gnyis na yod pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i gzugs dang kha dog la chags pa'i gnyen po byed pa dang*/

dmigs pa 'dod pa'i gzugs yid 'ong la dmigs pa'i phyir/ zil gnon gsum pa dang bzhi pa gnyis ni chos can/ rnam thar gnyis pa bzhin yin te/ ngo bo ma chags pa'i dge ba/ sa bsam gtan dang po gnyis kho na na yod pa/ bsam gtan dang po'i kha dog la chags pa'i gnyen po/ 'dod pa'i gzugs yid du 'ong mi 'ong rnams yul du byed pa'i phyir/ gzhan kha dog zil gnon bzhi chos can/ sdug pa'i rnam pa thar pa bzhin te/ ngo bo ma chags pa/ sa bsam gtan bzhi pa na yod pa/ mkhas pa'i gnyen po byad pa/ 'dod pa'i gzugs sdug mi sdug gnyis ka la dmigs nas 'jug pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ zad par bcu'o brgyad ma chags/ /bsam gtan mtha' na spyod yul ni/ /'dod pa gnyis ni gzugs med dag /spyod yul rang gi phung po bzhi/ /zhes byung*/ zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin chos can/ khyod la bcu yod de/ /zad par sa dang chu dang me dang rlung dang sngo ser dmar dkar ba dang nam mkha' dang rnam par shes pa'i skye mched kyi ting nge 'dzin dang bcu yod pa'i phyir/ zad par dang po brgyad chos can/ khyad par bzhi dang ldan te/ ngo bo ma chags pa'i dge ba/ chags pa'i gnyen po yin pa/ sa bsam gtan mtha' bzhi pa na yod pa/ 'dod pa'i gzugs kyi skye mched kyi spyod yul can yin pa'i phyir/ zad par phyi ma gnyis ni chos can/ khyad par gsum dang ldan te/ ngo bo ni rim pa bzhin gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug dag pa ba dang*/ spyod yul ni rang gi sa ba'i phung po bzhi la dmigs pa'i phyir/ sgra don yod de/ rnam thar ni dmigs pa la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i don dang*/ zil gnon gyis dmigs pa zil gyis gnon pa dang*/ zad par gyis dmigs pa de zad zad kyi bar du spro bar 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ rnam thar zil gnon zad par gsum gyi go rim yang bshad pa'i rim pa ltar yin te/ snga ma las phyi ma 'byung ba'i rim pa can yin pa'i phyir/lnga pa ni/

'gog pa bshad zin lhag ma ni/ /'dod chags dang bral sbyor bas thob/ /gzugs med ces bya khams gsum gyi/ /rten bcas lhag ma mi las skyes/ khams gnyis dag tu gzugs med pa/ /rgyu dang las kyi stobs kyis bskyed/ /gzugs kyi khams su bsam gtan rnams/ /de dag dang chos nyid kyi phyir/ zhes byung*/ yon tan de dag chos can/ thob tshul gyi khyad par yod de/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar thob tshul ni gnas gnyis par bshad zin la/ lhag ma nyer lnga ni sngar 'dris pas 'dod chags dang bral pa'i sgo nas thob pa dang*/ ma 'dris na sbyor bas thob par byed pa'i phyir/ rten gyi khyad par yod de/ gzugs med ces bya ba'i rnam thar bzhi dang zad par gnyis dang drug ni khams gsum gyi rten can la yod/ lhag ma bcu dag ni lung la rag las pas mi las skye ba'i phyir/ gal te/ khams gong na lung med pas mi skyon bsam gzugs kyang der mi skye bar thal te/ lung med pas so zhe na/ der 'chad nyan byed pa'i lung med kyang*/ bsam gzugs gnyis mi skye ba'i skyon med de/ de khams gong ma gnyis dag tu skye ba mi 'gal ba'i phyir te/ gzugs med pa la sngon goms pa'i skal mnyam gyi rgyu dang lan grangs gzhan la myong ba'i las kyi stobs kyis skyed la/ gzugs khams su ni bsam gtan rnams skye ba'i phyir te/ de dag dang chos nyid kyis kyang skye ba'i phyir ro/ /gnas brgyad pa'i tshig don bshad zin to/ /gsum pa rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba la/ bstan pa'i gnas tshang dang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol ba dang*/ thar pa 'dod pas bag yod brten rigs pa gsum/ dang po ni/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang*/ sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ / zhes byung*/ 'di la gnyis/ tshig don dang*/ spyi don gnyis/ dang po ni/ ston pa'i dam chos can/ khyod la rnam pa gnyis yod de lung gi dam chos dang*/

rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can gyi dam chos gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ snga ma ni sde snod gsum sder gtogs dang bcas pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni bslab pa gsum sder gtogs dang bcas pa la 'jog pa'i phyir/ dam pa'i chos de gnyis chos can/ khyod 'dzin par byed pa'i tshul yod de/ sde snod gsum gzhan la phyin ci ma log par smra ba'i sgo nas ston par byed pa dang*/ bslab gsum lta bu sgrub pa lag len du byas pa'i tshul gyis sgrub par byed pa kho na yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa spyi don la/ bstan pa'i gnas tshad ston pas gsungs tshul/ mkhas pas bshad tshul/ 'thad pa'i phyogs bzhag pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gsungs tshul bsdu na 'di ltar yod de/ mdo sde bskal bzang nas bstan pa yang dag lo lnga brgya dang*/ gzugs brnyan lo stong dang lnga brgya gnas par gsungs la/ gser 'phreng can gyi rtogs brjod las lo stong gnas par gsungs shing*/ zla ba'i snying po'i mdo las nyis stong*/ snying rje pad dkar du stong dang lnga brgya/ lha mo dri ma med pas zhus pa las/ lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar bshad pa sogs yod pa'i phyir/gnyis pa yod de/ mdzod rang 'grel las lung phran tshegs ltar bstan pa lo stong du gnas par gsungs shing*/ rdor gcod kyi 'grel par kā ma la shī las lo phyed dang sum stong gnas par bshad la/ thub dgongs su de ltar dang*/ 'bum ṭīka tu lnga stong dang*/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pa sogs ky-is kyang de ltar bshad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ rang lugs la lnga stong du gnas par bshad pa ltar yin te/ de ni lung rigs gnyis kyis 'grub cing*/ gzhan ni drang don dgongs gzhi can du shes pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ de la lung ni sngar ltar dang*/ lnga brgya pa phrag bcur gsungs pa'i dang po la dgra bcom/ gnyis pa la phyir mi 'ong*/ gsum pa la rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob pa mang du 'byung bas 'bras bu'i le'u gsum dang*/

de nas gsum la rim par shes rab kyi bslab pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa dang*/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa 'dzin pa mang du 'byung bas sgrub pa'i le'u gsum dang*/ de nas gsum la rim par mngon pa dang mdo sde dang 'dul ba 'dzin pa med pas lung gi le'u gsum dang*/ de nas bcu pa la lta spyod rnam dag med pas rtags tsam 'dzin pa 'byung bar gsungs pa'i lung dang rigs pas kyang 'grub pa'i phyir/ rigs pa gzhan gyis kyang grub ste/ da lta yang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu du ma byon nas bstan pa yang dag gnas par mdzad pa mngon sum gyis mthong ba'i phyir/ de ltar yin kyang mdo dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos dag las mi 'dra bar bshad pa de rnams dang mi 'gal te/ de ni dgongs gzhi dgos pa dngos la gnod byed gsum yod pa'i sgo nas drang don du 'grel ba'i phyir/ dgongs gzhi yod de/ sgrub pa khyad par can sngon ltar med pa la dgongs pa'i phyir/ dgos pa yod de/ gdul bya la skyo ba bskyed pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gnod byed yod de/ sher phyin phyi mdo las byang phyogs nas byang phyogs kyi rgyud du bstan pa rim gyis dar bar gsungs pa lta bu dang*/ lha mo dri ma med pa'i mdo las de mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gy-i yul du dam chos dar bar gsungs pa dang*/ sngar bshad pa'i rigs pas kyang 'grub pa'i phyir/ de dag kyang gling 'di lta bu'i dbang du byas kyi rnam pa thams cad du nges pa ni min te/ dus kyi 'khor lo las bstan pa'i gnas tshad mi 'dra ba zhig gsungs par ma zad/ sangs rgyas gzhan gyi bstan pa dang*/ ston pa nyid kyis kyang zhing gzhan dag tu chos bstan pa sogs kyi sgo nas bstan pa gnas shing spel ba sogs yod pa'i phyir/ 'o na/ da lta'i bar bstan pa'i gnas tshad las ci tsam 'das zhe na/ spyir rtogs pa'i bstan pa ni 'di tsam nas byung ba dang 'di nas med pa'i tshad shin tu dka' yang*/

rang re'i ston pa'i bstan pa ni rags rtsis gang nas byung ba'i tshad yod de/ sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan pa nas 'jog pa'i phyir/ ci tsam 'das pa'i tshang kyang yod de/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa nas bzung ste rang rang gi bstan rtsis mdzad pa'i bar gyi 'das lo la mi mthun pa du ma zhig bshad pa ltar yod pa'i phyir/ de ltar yod de/ mngon pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i yig cha du ma dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo lugs kyi bstan rtsis mdzad pa dang*/ de las gzhan gyi skabs su mdzad pa'i bstan rtsis rnams la ni mthun mi mthun mang po zhig mthong ba'i phyir/ 'dir gang gi rjes su 'brang zhe na/ sngar bshad pa de dag las rang stobs kyis 'di 'thad mi 'thad kyi khyad par dbye dka' yang re zhig phug pa yab sras kyi rjes su 'brang par bya ste/ ston pa de nyid lcags sprel la sku bltams pa'i lugs kyi zhi bar gshegs nas da lta'i shing yos 'di'i bar la lnga brgya pa phrag lnga rdzogs nas/ drug pa tshul khrims kyi le'u'i steng nas lo brgya dang bcu drug 'das shing da lta me 'brug gi steng na gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ bdag gis mngon pa'i chos 'di phal cher ni/ kha che bye brag smra ba'i tshul grub bshad/ /nyes par bshad gang de 'dir bdag gis nyes/ /dam chos tshul la thub rnams tshad ma yin/ /zhes byung*/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen chos can/ khyod kyis mngon pa mdzod kyi bstan bcos 'di lugs gang dang mthun par bshad tshul yod de/ bdag ste slob dpon khyod kyis mngon pa'i chos 'di phal cher ni kha che bye brag smra ba'i tshul grub ste grub mtha'i tshul bshad la/ mdo sde pa dang nyi 'og pa'i 'dod pa ltar yang cung zad re bshad pa'i phyir/ bstan bcos 'di las nyes par bshad pa'i cha mchis pa gang yin pa de chos can/ 'dir rtsom pa po bdag gis nyes bar bshad pa yin gyi/ 'di'i bshad gzhi mdo dang bstan bcos kyi tshig don gyi cha la skyon yod nas min te/

lung rtogs kyi dam pa'i chos kyi tshul la ni thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang*/ dgra bcom mkhas pa rnams tshad ma yin gyi/ so skye la ni 'khrul ba srid pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ ston pa 'jig rten mig ni zum gyur cing*/ /dbang gyur skye bo phal cher zad pa na/ /de nyid ma mthong rang dgar gyur pa yi/ /ngan rtog rnams kyis bstan pa 'di dkrugs so/ /rab byung rang byung bstan pa gces 'dzin rnams/ /mchog tu zhir gshegs 'gro mgon med pa na/ /'doms med yon tan 'joms par byed pa yi/ /dri mas dgar dgur deng sang 'di na spyod/ /de ltar thub pa dag gi bstan pa ni/ /lkog mar srog phyin 'dra dang dri ma rnams/ /stobs dang ldan pa'i dus su rig nas ni/ /thar pa 'dod pa dag gis bag yod byos/ /zhes byung*/ ston pa 'jig rten gyi mig lta bu ni zum pa ste mya ngan las 'das par gyur cing*/ chos kyi tshul la dbang du gyur pa'i skye bo skye 'phags phal cher zad pas mang po med pa'i dus na/ chos kyi de nyid de yin tshul ma mthong zhing rang dgar 'jug par gyur pa yi ngan rtog can rnams chos can/ khyed kyis thub pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa 'di dkrugs par byas te/ khyed cag gis lung gi bstan pa 'di'i tshig don gyi cha rnams log par bzung nas rang dgar 'jug pa dang*/ der ma zad rang byung sangs rgyas dang rang byung de'i bstan pa la gces par 'dzin pa'i 'phags pa rnams mchog chu zhi bar gshegs shing*/ 'gro ba'i mgon med pa na de dag la gdams ngag legs par 'doms pa med cing*/ bslab gsum gyi yon tan 'joms par byed pa yi dug gsum gyi dri mas kyang deng sang 'di na dga' dgur spyod pa de'i phyir/ de ltar thub pa dag gi bstan pa 'di ni lkog mar phyin pa'i srog ste dbugs dang 'dra bar yun thung zhing*/ snyigs ma'i dri ma ste skyon rnams stobs dang ldan pa'i dus su rig nas ni thar pa 'dod pa dag gis bag yod par byos shig ces skul zhing gdams pa la chos can/

dgos pa yod de/ bag yod ni yon tan kun gyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa mjug gi don la/ mdzad pa po gang yin pa dang*/ lo paṇa gang gis bsgyur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ chos mngon pa mdzod kyi tshig le'ur byas pa slob dpon shākya'i dge slong dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// zhes byung ste go sla'o/ /slob dpon 'di'i rnam thar ni rgya gar chos 'byung las rgyas par bshad pa ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig ste/ kho bo'i bsam tshod ltar na slob dpon 'di dam chos 'dzin pa la shing rta chen po thogs med nyid dang kun nas mtshungs pa'i phyir na 'phags pa'i gang zag chen po zhig yin par nges pas so skye'i mkhas pa tsam du 'dzin mi rung bar sems so/ /des na mdo sde pa'am sems tsam pa yin pas so skye'o snyam du ma 'dzin cig /gal te slob dpon 'dis sku tshe'i stod du theg chen gyi gzhung la skur ba btab pa'i lo rgyus 'dug pas 'phags par ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ 'gal ba cung zad kyang med de/ 'phags pa yin yang dgos pa'i dbang gis mdzad tshul sna tshogs ston pa du ma zhig mthong phyir ro/ /slob dpon 'di'i thugs la ni 'bum sde go dgu'i gzhung mnga' bas 'phags pa'i yul du phyis byung ba'i mkhas pa rnams su ma zad/ sngon gyi paṇa chen mkhas pa dag las kyang mkhas pa chen por gyur pas na sangs rgyas gnyis pa zhes grags pa ltar don dang mthun pa yin no/ /gnyis pa lo paṇa gang gis bsgyur ba ni/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra ste rgyal ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tstsha ba bande ste btsun pa dpal brtsegs kyis rgya skad las bod skad du bsgyur cing zhus te 'chad nyan gyis legs par gtan la dbab pa'o// //smras pa/ thub dbang gsung gi rgya mtsho las 'ongs legs bshad yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /rnam dpyod yangs pa'i hub gcig gis bzhes skal ldan gdung ba sel phyir du/ /skyugs mkhas sngon med drang srong chen po dbyig gnyen zhal sgo las 'ongs pa'i/

/chos mngon snying po 'chi med bdud rtsi lhar bcas 'gro 'di'i bsos su gyur/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi phung po las/ /thun mong nang don rig pa stong pa'i gzhung*/ /mang yang don gyi snying po kun bsdus pa/ /chos mngon gzhung gzhan dag las 'di nyid 'phags/ /gang 'di'i dgongs pa 'grel pa'i bstan bcos ni/ /'phags pa'i yul dang phyogs 'dir 'ga' mchis kyang*/ /la la tshig don gnyis ka ha cang bsdus/ /'ga' zhig sgros tshe blo chung 'jug par dka'/ /de phyir tshig don gnyis ka 'tsham pa zhig/ sngon gyi mkhas pa'i gzhung mang dag las ni/ /ma nor bshad pa'i cha rnams legs bsdus te/ /rang gzhan 'ga' la phan srid snyam nas bris/ /rtsa ba gar song 'dir song med gyur na/ /de yi don la phan khyad chung mthong nas/ /nges pa brnyed phyir sangs rgyas gnyis pa yi/ /rtsa ba'i gzhung rnams rdzogs par drangs te bkod/ /kwa ye grogs dag 'jig rten khyim pa dang*/ /rnam dbye med pa'i lto gos tsam zhig la/ /'bad nas mi tshe stong zad mi byed par/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas legs bshad dag la gzigs/ /chos mngon rgya mtsho'i dgongs don dpag par dka'/ /bdag ni blo chung sbyangs pa'i stobs kyang dman/ /de phyir 'di la ma bshad log bshad dag /gang zhig mchis pa de ni bdag gis nongs/ /legs par bshad las thob pa'i dge des bdag /tshe rabs kun tu dam chos 'dzin pa dang*/ /gzhung bshad 'dis kyang mngon pa'i chos tshul kun/ /dar zhing rgyas la yun ring gnas gyur cig /ces mngon pa mdzod kyi ṭīkka rgyal sras 'phags tshogs thams cad kyi dgongs don gsal byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ co ne'i bstan pa'i mnga' bdag kau'u shwi nang so yes kyis gnang sbyin dang bcas pas bskul shing*/ rang nyid kyang dad pa kun nas bslangs te co ne'i slob dpon pa grags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas rang dgon du legs par sbyar ba'i spar gyi yi ge pa ni dka' bcu pa blo bzang bsam 'grub ste/
'dis kyang kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang*/ gzhan dag la phan thogs par gyur cig/ // dge'o// //
